title: Crowd Games
shortDescription: A collaborative mobile game where the whole audience steers one shared avatar at the same time, turning a passive crowd into a single, synchronized team.
longDescription: Every player uses their phone as a simple left/right controller, and the more people who pick the same direction, the stronger the movement becomes. There is no app to install: visitors scan a QR code, join in seconds, and instantly become part of one collective player on the big screen. It adapts to almost any goal - a branded story journey, a networking energizer, a live poll, or a knowledge quiz - and to any theme, from space travel to sustainability. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, real-time scene management, and the journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Instant, No-App Participation
highlights.description: The whole room joins in seconds by scanning a QR code in the browser, so even large, passive audiences activate with zero friction and no hardware to hand out.

highlights.title: Reshape the Mechanic
highlights.description: Reshape the mechanic itself: swap the input from phones to buttons, gestures, or motion; split the crowd into teams that each steer their own avatar and race head to head; or turn steering into a live vote, where the avatar moves to catch A or B. Layer on vertical-lane gameplay, sponsor editions with branded vessels and rewards, or tournament and leaderboard rounds.

highlights.title: Any World, One Game
highlights.description: Reskin the same game for any world - Space Travel, Holiday Travel, a sustainability mission, a culture-and-history quest, a music festival, or a fully branded product story.

highlights.title: Optional Crowd Data
highlights.description: Add a data layer that captures engagement rate, player count (peak, average, per round), session duration, score stats, and a heatmap of movement, giving the client clear proof of participation and reach.

highlights.title: Pairs With Your Stack
highlights.description: Pair with Visitor Identificator for rewards and follow-up, Shared Gallery for the collective result and shareable cards, Journey Manager to make it one stop on a longer route, or a Leaderboard for live competition.

states.experience: An animated attract loop invites participation.
states.configurable: Attract visuals, loop duration, background music
states.data: Idle duration, foot-traffic visibility, attract loop impressions

states.trigger: Players step into the detection area
states.experience: The game explains the rules and how to join, using visuals and/or voiceover.
states.feedback: On-screen diagrams, voice guidance, theme visuals
states.data: Instruction duration, drop-off rate, engagement tracking

states.trigger: Participants scan the QR code to join
states.experience: The system waits for players to connect - the QR code is shown and the lobby forms.
states.feedback: QR display with join animation, loading audio cues
states.configurable: Max player count, waiting time, QR link logic
states.data: Join rate, time to connect, user identifiers

states.trigger: All players joined or the countdown expires
states.experience: The intro animation plays and the countdown begins.
states.feedback: Countdown numbers, start jingle, animated transition to gameplay
states.configurable: Countdown length, intro visuals, launch sound
states.data: Countdown duration, drop-off at launch, time to play

states.experience: The crowd actively steers the shared avatar - collecting, dodging, solving, or moving together.
states.feedback: Responsive sound design, real-time visuals, avatar animation
states.configurable: Gameplay type, difficulty, input mapping, audio theme
states.data: Motion input, group accuracy, performance metrics

states.trigger: Game ends through success, fail, or timeout
states.experience: Score, team result, or feedback screen appears, and players receive a shareable result on their phones.
states.feedback: Celebration animation, music fanfare, score visuals
states.configurable: Result style, reward display, next-steps prompt
states.data: Score breakdown, success rate, group contribution analysis

states.trigger: Timeout, participant inactivity, or manual stop
states.experience: The session ends early and resets to attract mode.
states.feedback: Fade-out visuals, system tone, idle loop restart
states.data: Abort reason, duration until cancel, user retention
